description:
Activate Marneus by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Marneus, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar two times by sacrificing the Astartes Warriors, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Astartes Warriors die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
The Treasures enter the battlefield, triggering Marneus, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
